en:
That's where my detective work
leads us. It all fits!
Uh... Uuuhhh...

Sweet Korekiyo, there are times when it's
necessary to admit defeat.
A-Admit...?
Yeah... Okay...
So you...finally admit you did it.
Unfortunately...yes.

Yes... It's unfortunate.
Very, very unfortunate.
My one regret... My only regret...
...was not being able to make <CLT=cltSTRONG>100 friends<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
100...f-friends?
Kehehe... It was my dream to make 100 friends.

Ooh, it's so unfortunate!
I was so close to 100!

Wh-What are you...talking about?
I do not understand a word of this.

Who gives a fuck!? Let's vote for this kooky
bastard and be done with this already!
Roger that! One Voting Time, comin' up!
THE-HEART-RACING-EXCITEMENT-AS...
The heart-racing excitement...!

As the blackened and the spotless
finally face off...
It's...VOTING TIME!!!
